about: Trick placements for fpv.fpv-run `tricks` (s = arc length in m along data/racing_line.json where the trick starts). tEstimate = time from the zone/curvature profile (no trick time).

tricks.why: entry hall: punch up between the mushroom caps (AC1 top 4.46, hall ceiling 9), cut throttle, float over the mound
nose down into the groove cut through the mound -> trench 0x375
-12 hall: cut throttle over the 6.4 x 5.9 m floor hole
floor chute: 33 deg dive under the roof lip into the -18 tunnel
chimney A over 0x1E0 (10 x 10 m, lid at -12): punch up ~13 m, cut throttle, float, drop back
0x1DC under chimney B (open above): one flat yaw spin
roll out over the pit edge (lid 3.4 m above: no room for a split-S)
THE PIT: nose-over, ~16 m near-ballistic drop, pull out over the two pit-bottom Rippers
ramp hall 0x150 swoop (20 m wide, ceiling -45)
-60: pop up out of trench 0x122 into room 0x121
west egg chamber: float-up reveal over the eggs, larvae and the toxic hive
roll into the Surface portal swirl

skipped.reason: the pit lid (-30) is only ~3.4 m above the line at the edge; a half-roll + half-loop down needs ~2 r of height above the entry and would invert the drone under the lid. Roll + nose-over dive instead.
not requested by DESIGN 4; the tallest straight spaces (chimneys, pit) are 10 m wide - a loop of radius >= 3.5 m would need a straight 10 m+ run inside them
